scope: Every image file tracked in this repository. An asset that is not listed here is not cleared for publication.
policy: No upstream image, icon set, clip-art, texture, font file, or application screenshot is redistributed here. A permissive license on a surrounding repository is not a rights record for an image taken from it.
Each asset below is original vector work authored for this repository and is covered by the repository LICENSE (MIT).
Illustrations are drawn diagrams. None of them is a screenshot of the Obsidian application, and none of them is evidence that anything rendered in a running app.
"Obsidian" names the third-party application these skills target. No vendor logo, product icon, or UI asset is included, and no affiliation or endorsement is claimed.
